newsitem.title: UK: BZW appoints new chief administrative head.
newsitem.headline: BZW appoints new chief administrative head.

text.p: BZW, the investment banking arm of British banking giant Barclays Plc, said on Monday it had appointed Naguib Kheraj as chief administrative officer.
Kheraj will join the firm in September from independent investment bank Robert Fleming where he was co-head of global capital markets and a member of its executive committee, BZW said in a statement.
Kheraj, a Cambridge graduate with a double first degree in economics, was previously chief financial officer for Salomon Brothers in Europe. He joined Salomons in 1986, BZW added.
In his new role he will report to BZW chief executive Bill Harrison, who joined BZW from Flemings nearly a year ago.
Kheraj will have overall responsibility for support functions at BZW and will become chairman of its operating committee.
BZW also said it had appointed Nick Kelly from Swiss bank UBS as human resources director. At UBS he was head of human resources for corporate finance and had previously worked at J.P. Morgan.
